messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for chart=redwood-api v2.14.0 -> v2.15.0 in cluster=prod-eu. canary=10%.

deploy-bot: post-deploy hook detected values override for `feature.experimental` and a linked ConfigMap `rate-limits` changed. Pausing canary for manual review. See runbook: https://go/runbook/canary-pause

maya: ack. what changed in the configmap? key names?

tariq: looks like `burst_limit` and `default_tier` were added. not sure if they were intended for prod. I see the PR author is mobile-team.

oliver: can we hotpatch values only in canary namespace (helm upgrade --reuse-values --set-file...) to validate? or do a rollback to v2.14.0 to be safe?

maya: hotpatch would be faster but risky if configschema mismatch. rollback is safe but will delay the release notes delivery.

tariq: opt: 1) rollback global release; 2) pin chart to 2.14.0 for the remainder of change window; 3) do isolated hotpatch in canary namespace and run smoke tests. prefer 3 + chart pin if tests pass.

deploy-bot: Requested actions:
- pause canary (done)
- create rollback PR (automated): https://git/repo/pulls/3421
- snapshot canary namespace: snapshot-prod-canary-1972468100

release-manager: We should also update release notes with the configmap change and flag it as "opt-in". If we pin, add a note: "chart pinned due to config change".

maya: quick checklist for hotpatch path:
```bash
helm upgrade redwood-api ./charts/redwood-api \n  --namespace prod-canary \n  --reuse-values \n  --set feature.experimental=true \n  --set config.rate_limits.burst_limit=200
```
Run smoke: `/run smoke prod-canary` (ci-cd-bot)

oliver: if smoke fails, roll forward to rollback PR. If passes, merge pin-and-docs PR and continue canary with 20% for 30m.

tariq: +1. also add metric guard: request_latency_p95 < 350ms and error_rate < 0.5%

deploy-bot: smoke run queued by ci-cd-bot. ETA ~8m. I will unpause canary only after explicit `@release-manager` sign-off.

release-manager: I'll review smoke and the PRs. If green -> pin chart + merge release notes update -> unpause and increase canary.

maya: thanks. I'll follow up in PR comments and attach test traces.

oliver: :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Note: rolling back will trigger DB migration guard check. If migrations present, manual intervention required.

maya: no migrations in this release. proceeding.

deploy-bot: last automated status update. smoke finished: PASSED. metrics within thresholds.

release-manager: merging pin+notes now. will unpause in 2m and ramp to 20%.

tariq: thanks team. post-release action: run postmortem doc stanza for change window impact.

deploy-bot: canary resumed at 20%.

maya: monitoring :eyes:. will report any anomalies.

oliver: closing thread once GA completed.
